in_sanskrit.name: इप्सिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has a strong desire or longing, one who wishes for something earnestly.

in_hindi.name: इप्सिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Sanskrit word 'इप्सित' (ipsit) means 'desire' or 'wish'. The feminine form of this word is 'इप्सिता' (ipsita), which means 'one who has a strong desire or longing, one who wishes for something earnestly'.

in_telugu.name: ఇప్సితా

in_marathi.name: Ipsita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, or Wish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ipsita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ipsita is derived from the Sanskrit word इप्सिता (ipsita) which means 'desire', 'wish', or 'longing'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Ipsita is associated with the fulfillment of desires and is often invoked for the granting of wishes. This name is rich in spiritual meaning and symbolizes the deep longing and yearning for the attainment of one's heart's desires.
